- Shorts look sharp: they were capped by height, so tall 1080p Shorts dropped to 480p. Now they play at full quality
- Shorts load faster: the next ones get ready while you watch
- Your Shorts: the Shorts tab starts from the Shorts YouTube picks for you, and follows your own sequence when you're signed in
- Shorts are never cropped: the whole video, with acrylic bars of its own colors around it, and a soft blur fade at the top and bottom so the text reads
- The app's bottom bar stays on Shorts, and the buttons and title sit above it
- Tap to pause or play, with a little animation; drag along the bar at the bottom to move through a Short
- Save a Short to a playlist
- History: search everything you've watched, and the Shorts you watched get their own row
- New installs start with Shorts off (turn them on in Settings)
